[8-bit] Another addresss related to pause

128 = unpaused
204 = paused

Note: has the same inconsistency issue as the other pause address, jumps to 204 sometimes even when not paused. However, seems to be consistent in stage 2 at least

[8-bit] address for game pause

0 = unpaused
255 = paused or In the menu screen

Note: this address was one of ithe closest I could find that seems to be consistent when you pause and unpause. However, it seems to jump to 255 for 2 frames sometimes, and breaks completely for the first section of stage 2

[32-bit] An address that changes whenever an Enemy is defeated or crash collects a wumpa. It also Includes the star at the end of the level as well

NOTE: This address still changes when enemies are defeated by other means and not by crash, like  Stage 2's Obstacle

[8-bit] Game Status

0 = at main menu
1 = In-game
[8-bit] Increases by 1 when you transition into Stage 2, and goes down when you go to the main menu. helpful for setting stage 2 achievements

[8-bit] a Counter that goes up when an enemy is defeated/wumpa collected.

Note: the issue with this counter is that there's no way to reset it back to 0 other than rebooting the game

[32-bit] Another Timer

Seems to get enabled when In-game. 

Resets when pausing and unpausing, and transitioning between stages

34533216 = In-game
